tools.name: get_rate_receipt
tools.description: Return a stored Rate Receipt by id (rr_...). Schema swapeazi.rate_receipt.v1. Includes max_age_seconds. Free callers see a masked publisher; a router key sees the source name.

tools.name: plan_payment
tools.description: One call instead of five: give an amount and a corridor (e.g. amount 500, corridor EUR-XAF, payer_type business) or the payment in plain words (q). Returns the routes on record ordered by evidence of what landed ("not enough evidence yet" and no rank where it is thin), the official and street rates

tools.name: search_routes
tools.description: Ask in plain words how to land a payment, e.g. 'land 500 EUR in Douala on MTN today' or 'USD 25,000 to a supplier in Lagos'. Returns clean JSON: the payment as understood (amount, currencies, country, payout method, operator), the official rate (legal peg or central bank) and the street rate as sepa

tools.name: request_payment_approval
tools.description: For a payment run: the payments awaiting approval with amount, route, assessment and approval_digest, the approver role, and the payments not ready with their lifecycle state and reason. Never approves: a named person approves with approve_payment_run.

tools.name: track_payment_settlement
tools.description: Spec v1.0 name for payment_run_status: each payment's lifecycle state (CREATED, ANALYSED, QUOTED, ROUTE_SELECTED, AWAITING_APPROVAL, APPROVED, SUBMITTED, PROCESSING, SETTLED, FAILED, REJECTED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, REQUIRES_REVIEW) with the reason. SETTLED only on the provider's own confirmation.

tools.name: corridor_cost
tools.description: Read-only corridor evidence: public published rates, public posts, on-chain pool prints and user receipts, summarised by corridor and provider type (bank, fintech, card, stablecoin). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_corridor_capacity, plan_payment, search_routes, corridor_cost · Private data: get_corridor_capacity, plan_payment, search_routes, corridor_cost · Public sink: plan_payment, search_routes, corridor_cost · Destructive: swapeazi_beneficiary_check, request_payment_approval.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_corridor_capacity, plan_payment, search_routes, corridor_cost · Private data: get_corridor_capacity, plan_payment, search_routes, corridor_cost · Public sink: plan_payment, search_routes, corridor_cost · Destructive: swapeazi_beneficiary_check, request_payment_approval

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
